clips.title: The story
paras: Behind Deathknell, the Whispering Forest lies quiet beneath western Tirisfal’s cliffs. Its lake, giant mushroom ring, and uncanny wildlife break the stillness, while corruption stirs beneath the soil.

Beyond Northface Rock and Bandarion Keep, the Whispering Forest feels far removed from plague-touched Tirisfal. Afflicted deer and roaming predators share its woods with a tranquil lake. Nearby, giant mushrooms form a ring beneath a hovering cloud of mist, glowing with uncanny energy. The ghostly Knight of Mourning wanders among them, bound by oath. Natural magic lingers here in a land scarred by the Scourge.
